name: occupancy_within_pair_randomization
caption: Within-pair randomisation on unique finite seed pairs. Each permutation assigns the observed number of within-pairs at random. p = (1+n_extreme)/(1+n_perm), n_perm=9999, seed=0. One-sided on gap. Not a trajectory bootstrap.
alt_text: Within-pair randomisation on unique finite seed pairs. Each permutation assigns the observed number of within-pairs at random. p = (1+n_extreme)/(1+n_perm), n_perm=9999, seed=0. One-sided on gap. Not a trajectory bootstrap.
limitations: physics s1 has no last-band within diagonal (n_within_pairs=9). Leave-one-seed-out and within-pair randomisation are tests on these ten texts. They do not re-derive trajectory-bootstrap CIs from vectors (ADR-0021). Do not read a cluster count off UMAP. Domain ≡ seed instance (ADR-0020).
